name: The Moss-twined Heart
label: Quest
description: The Moss-twined Heart is a strange, corrupted core harvested from the monstrous timberling Blackmoss the Fetid. Smothered in oily, dark moss, the heart…
intro: The Moss-twined Heart is a strange, corrupted core harvested from the monstrous timberling Blackmoss the Fetid. Smothered in oily, dark moss, the heart unnervingly continues to beat on its own, prompting an investigation by the botanist Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The heart of Blackmoss the Fetid is covered with a dark, oily moss. In fact, the only way to tell this is a heart is from its slow, rhythmic beat... A beat that continues even now.
Perhaps Denalan will want to see this heart.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend! You have something for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: ...What is this? A timberling heart?? It's covered with a foul moss!
Thank you for bringing this to me, friend. I will examine the heart and, if fortune shines, determine the nature of the moss about it.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
